mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% consistently reduces equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate cash flows become more valuable.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, causing equity sell-offs as revenue growth expectations fall, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) during supply chain disruptions increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction (HOUST) consistently reflects improving consumer confidence and housing market strength, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), further unemployment declines signal wage inflation pressures that trigger monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate supply-side shocks that increase input costs and reduce real demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over the 20-day horizon.
